en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1661 - Aban ibn Taghlib narrated from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as)
regarding a man who dies without any heirs or any master (to whom he is affiliated):

"He falls under the category mentioned in this verse:
'They ask you about the spoils (anfal)...' (Surah Al-Anfal 8:1)."
